name: Structure-based target prediction benchmark datasets
description: A collection of benchmark datasets for evaluating structure-based computational methods that predict molecular targets of small molecules or ligands.
reputation: Moderately adopted within the computational chemistry and structure-based drug-discovery community as a standard set of tasks for evaluating target/affinity prediction methods.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on structure-based methods; heterogeneous datasets and evaluation protocols across studies; risk of data leakage/target overlap between train/test splits; performance varies strongly with dataset size and labeling quality.
